every_position_composed.reason: In frame 4 of the first site, an unreadable dark card covers the left 3D anchor rack, whereas the second site cleanly hides the card during the camera transition in frames 4 and 7 so the 3D subject is unobstructed.

explains_the_project.reason: Both sites use the exact same 3D factory assembly line—from the token flood in frame 3 to the digest press in frame 5, anchor rack in frame 6, and seven host lanes in frame 8—to clearly visualize how Straitjacket processes logs.

craft_of_the_3d.reason: Both sites feature the identical well-crafted, grounded 3D machinery with beveled metallic edges, subtle grid shadows, and distinct color-coded tokens across frames 1 through 9.

type_and_layout.reason: While both share the same clean typography, the first site displays broken, low-contrast faded text cards during transitions in frames 4 and 7, whereas the second site keeps text crisp when settled (frames 3, 5, 6, 8) and completely out of the way when moving.

overall.reason: Both sites share the same excellent 3D visualization and design, but the second site wins because it cleanly hides the UI cards during camera transitions (frames 4 and 7) rather than leaving illegible dark boxes overlapping the 3D machinery.
